parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is a switch button made of durable plastic, typically circular or rectangular in shape, located on the front face of the wall switch socket.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main control for turning electrical circuits on or off, allowing users to operate connected devices or lights.
parts.Movement_description: It moves by pressing inward or toggling between on and off positions, returning to its resting state via an internal spring mechanism.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is another switch button made of plastic, identical in function and material to the first switch, positioned adjacent to it.
parts.Functional_description: It controls a separate electrical circuit, allowing independent operation of two connected devices or lighting systems.
parts.Movement_description: It operates through a press or toggle motion, engaging an internal mechanism to open or close the circuit.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or faceplate of the wall switch socket, made of polycarbonate plastic, providing structural support and housing for the switches and sockets.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the electrical components securely, insulates the wiring, and provides a safe and aesthetic interface for user interaction.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and fixed to the wall, serving as the mounting surface for the switches and sockets.
